questions.q: What does Zimbardo say about personality consistency across situations?
questions.why: Zimbardo argues personalities are not static but depend on social circumstances.

questions.q: Which experiment demonstrated obedience to authority through electric shocks?
questions.why: The Milgram experiment illustrated obedience to authority.

questions.q: In the Stanford prison experiment, what identifier replaced prisoners' names?
questions.why: Prisoners were given numbers instead of names.

questions.q: What does Zimbardo suggest you do when an authority is unjust?
questions.why: He advises refusing to follow unjust authority.

questions.q: How does Zimbardo define the situational approach?
questions.why: He states actions are determined by situational factors.
